quote: I love driving my GR Yaris hard, and my insurance quote is high. Is there anything I can do about it, and is the loan fine?
context: Enthusiast driving style holds his score at 78; autopay on; 47 payments left at 6.4%

bestMove.title: Try free driving coaching, then re-check an insurance quote
bestMove.message: Your driving score is 78, held down by fast launches and speeding. Coaching on those two habits could move it toward 93, and a simulated improved-score quote is about $186 a month versus your current $212, roughly $316 a year. Your loan is on autopay at a fair rate, so nothing needs to change there.
bestMove.whyNotOthers: Refinancing saves little at 6.4%, extra principal is optional, and optional service coverage can wait; coaching costs nothing and can be started in the app today.
bestMove.guardrails: The improved-score quote is an illustration, not a promise. Coaching shares no data with insurers.

notes: Toyyo-authored case: the figures come from Toyyo's own simulated persona data and engines, not from the hackathon data pack. All data is synthetic.
The driver's occupation is illustrative; the persona data does not specify one.
Next-step label follows the pack's definitions: Self-service (customer does it in the app), Follow-up (a specialist continues), Offer (an eligible product offer).
The GR Yaris was never sold in the US, so this is a fictional US-dollar scenario.
Engine ranking: coaching first, extended service coverage second.
